speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: The cuff is done. Leave it done. I have said the other thing once, and I am looking at the desk, not at thee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sat. I have nothing to put in the empty place, and I am not going to find something during a psalm.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. The lesson is the next work. Thou mayst be in the pew for it without beginning early.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in the pew. Dinner is after. I have not forgotten the order of the day.
